senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of זור)to surround; to keep off; to set apart. V. נָזִיר, נֵזֶר.
(denom. of נָזִיר) to vow to be a Nazarite;to dedicate one’s self to nazariteship.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 3:2">Naz. III, 2</cite> <he>שנ׳ שתי וכ׳</he> who vows to be a Nazarite for two terms.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 3:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>מי שנ׳ והוא וכ׳</he> if one makes the vow while in a burial ground.
<cite ref="Nazir 17a:10">Ib. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לא תִינְזוֹר</he> thou must not vow (while in a burial ground).
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 1:5">Ib. I, 5</cite> <he>אחת גדולה נָזַרְתִּי</he> I meant by my vow one nazaritic term which I consider a long one.
Ned. 3ᵇ נימא קרא לִיזּוֹר the text (Num. VI, 2) ought to read lizzor (instead of l’hazzir).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 1:1:3">Y. Naz. I, beg. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>במתכוין לִיזּוֹר</he> when he intended to vow nazariteship; a. fr.

<cite ref="Nedarim 4a:11">Ned. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיַזִּיר מכולן</he> (<cite ref="Nazir 3b:10">Naz. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>שיִדּוֹר</he>) unless he vows abstinence from all of them (mentioned <cite ref="Numbers 6:3">Num. VI, 3</cite>).
Sifré Num. 22 להַזִּיר אף את אחרים l’hazzir (Num. VI, 2) includes also the imposition of nazariteship on others (one’s son &c.).
<cite ref="Numbers 6:2">Ib.</cite> <he>את עצמו מַזִּיר וכ׳</he> himself he may obligate, but he cannot obligate others; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:11">Num. R. s. 10</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Nazir 19a:1">Naz. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אע״פ שלא הביא ה׳</he> even if he did not bring the due sacrifice, he must resume his nazariteship.
<cite ref="Nazir 19a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אימתי ה׳ וכ׳</he> when can he resume &c.? After he brought the sacrifice (<cite ref="Numbers 6:12">Num. VI, 12</cite>).

senses.gloss: (with ל) to dedicate one’s self to. Sifré l. c. המצוה להִנָּזֵר לשם the merit of nazariteship consists in the dedication of one’s self to the Lord (in the sacred motive).
(with מ) to abstain from; to renounce. Ib. 131 הִנָּזֵר מתורתו … והוא נִזּוֹר renounce the law of Moses, and he did renounce; Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ הִינָּזֵר.
